entries.note: Han 2019 (PMID 31437865, epub 2019-08-22) quote verbatim in abstract. Dog model (PMID 29180359) epub 2017-11-27, after revaprazan human pH (Kim 2010, PMID 20880169): retro. Tegoprazan, oral, healthy volunteers (unselected), year 2019 correct.

Kim 2019 JPET (PMID 30894456), CJ HealthCare authors; received 2018-11-12, epub 2019-03-20, i.e. after the Korean phase 3 (NCT03006874, 2016-17) and approval. Run date unpublished; retrodiction cannot be shown, so prospective treatment stands but is a rule question.

entries.note: Lee 2019 (PMID 30843245, epub 2019-03-06) quote verbatim; primary week-8 healing, non-inferiority design in note. Kim 2019 rat (PMID 30894456) epub 2019-03-20 post-dates it: retro. Tegoprazan, oral, unselected EE patients correct.

Choi 2025 JNM (PMC12241910) quote verbatim. Status untested stands, but this rat study was run after tegoprazan's 2018 approval and is not what the class relied on; the relied-on tox package is unpublished. Model/first-use year arguably wrong.
Jeong 2022 full text (PMC9230797, epub 2022-06-18): abstract sentence verbatim. Opening untested at first use, in_silico, prediction_level class correct.
Quote verbatim; Table 6 gives 48.9 obs vs 49.6 pred (50 mg) and 70.4 vs 63.0 (day 7, 100 mg); observed from Han 2019 [15]. Caco-2 and Kp optimized to clinical data, so retro is right.
Jeong 2021 abstract (Europe PMC, epub 2021-05-29): quote verbatim. PK-only model, no pH readout; untested opening entry and year 2021 fine. Full text not reopened.

Kim MS 2022 full text (PMC9230547, epub 2022-06-03): quote verbatim. PD kin/Imax/IC50 estimated from digitized phase 1 pH data, so retro. Proposed BID regimen untested in patients; no dose entry correct.
Wu 2024 full text (PMC10904617, epub 2024-02-16): quote verbatim. Opening untested; class level. Note the five case-study P-CABs exclude tegoprazan and fexuprazan; only revaprazan is a member.
Quote verbatim: revaprazan 200 mg predicted 57.1% vs 42.2% observed (Kim 2010, public), onset 4 h vs <=2 h. Revaprazan was the verification compound, so retro, not same; within 2x.
Jung 2026 full text (PMC12823312, epub 2026-01-15): quote verbatim. Opening untested; year 2026 correct (received 2025, published 2026).

Jung 2026 (PMC12823312, 2026-01-15) quote verbatim. Fitted to published tegoprazan phase 1 pH data: retro. Tegoprazan, oral, unselected correct; steady-state 60% vs reported 52-68% would support within_2x over direction_only.
Jung 2026 abstract sentence verbatim; model run for fexuprazan from published phase 1 data. Opening untested entry for the fexuprazan track; year 2026, fexuprazan, oral, unselected correct.

Jung 2026 Results sentence verbatim (fexuprazan 40 mg 69% vs reported 55-70%; Table 3 day-7 simulation 56%). Fitted to those published phase 1 data: retro, within_2x. Fexuprazan, oral, healthy volunteers (unselected), 2026 correct.

Fexuprazan phase III EE head-to-head (Jeong 2024, J Clin Med, doi:10.3390/jcm13113262) is RETRACTED; correctly absent, worth a note so it is not re-added.
Tegoprazan Korean NERD phase 3 and TRIUMpH NERD (GERD patients) are additional efficacy patient_trials; no status change.

Zastaprazan (JP-1366; Korean approval 2024 for erosive oesophagitis) is a Korean P-CAB the tile does not list; its only model found is a GERD-patient popPK model (doi:10.1002/psp4.13228, 2024) that describes exposure, not acid or healing, so no track needed unless zastaprazan is added to the class.
rule_questions: Efficacy: when the only published disease model (Kim 2019 rat GERD) was submitted after the phase 3 finished and after approval, and its run date is unpublished, is it prospective or `retrodiction: true` (retro rather than same)? The rules key on run date, which no source gives.

Safety: if the class relied on an unpublished regulatory tox package and the only public animal safety study was run post-approval, should the cell stay `untested` on the unpublished package (model_first_use_year pre-clinic, unknown) or be built on the post-approval study as the draft does? And is that study then a retrodiction of the comparable-AE phase 3 data?

Dose: does a model that states only an effective oral mg/kg (no exposure or occupancy target) count as stating a dose target, so that 'reached, drug worked' gives `same`, or does it stay `untested` as drafted?
